known.title: Stop promising nightly coverage after switching to local tests

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a worker runs the related tests for a change after this setting takes effect.
This setting selects the local-test instructions in `src/forge/worker.py:50-58`, which tell every worker that a nightly full run covers the remaining tests. The picker repeats that assurance for unselected tests in `src/forge/fasttest.py:850-854`. This change removes the repository's scheduled full-suite job, while the remaining nightly workflows run only subsets, so that coverage is no longer configured. The coordinator's note addresses the regenerated workflow and repaired test expectations, but not these messages. Correct the assurance so agents do not rely on a full run that is not scheduled.
Adds work: correct the local-test coverage messages; F 3 x H 2 = 6; 2 x C = 4
